_comment: Experiment A corpus manifest, rebuilt August 2026. Full article text is NOT redistributed: it is copyrighted news reporting. Each record carries the outlet, publication date and source URL so that any reader can open the original and verify the corresponding gold annotation. The 'excerpt_basis' field records which part of the article the annotation was made from.
supersedes: corpus 1.0, used in the first version of the manuscript; those materials were not archived and the corpus was rebuilt from verifiable sources for this revision
